response.justification: Bogdan demonstrates deep technical breadth across distributed systems, high-throughput architectures, and AI-agent infrastructure, with strong ownership and operational experience — including on-call readiness and agile exposure — aligning well with the role's core demands. His hands-on work with AI-driven tooling at re:cinq and open-source system design shows comfort with AI-native engineering. Minor concerns include limited explicit Python mastery and no clear evidence of stakeholder management at staff level, but his track record suggests strong adaptability.
strengths: Proven experience in AI-agent infrastructure and agentic code generation workflows at re:cinq
Extensive background in high-throughput, low-latency distributed systems (e.g., millions of requests/sec at Dunnhumby)
Strong operational ownership evidenced by on-call readiness, CI/CD setup, and open-source project maintenance
concerns: Python expertise not explicitly detailed despite being a must-have
Limited evidence of cross-functional stakeholder leadership at staff level
German language proficiency is basic, potentially limiting local collaboration
